mount.note: The GY-521 (MPU6050) sits with its Y axis up: gravity reads +9.8 on Y (2026-09-07), so a roll of +90 deg maps the chip's Y onto base_link's Z; its Y gyro is the yaw rate. The board publishes base_link -> imu_link from this; the laptop reads the accelerometer through the same rotation to know which way is up.
